C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, simplification, and expressing results in lowest terms

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly rewrites a mixed number such as 2 3/2 into 3 1/2.
Tag when the normalization changes only the representation, not the value, to make subtraction feasible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is not normalization of an improper mixed number.
Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator or simplifies a final answer.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and convert fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when the solution converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when the step only subtracts numerators after common denominators are already established.

skills.name: Align whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers as whole plus 0 over a matching denominator and separate mixed numbers into whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when the solution explicitly subtracts whole parts and fraction parts as separate components of a mixed-number expression.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for pure fraction-minus-fraction items with no whole-number component.
Do not tag for borrowing itself; borrowing is a separate regrouping operation.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator, including subtracting fraction parts inside mixed-number subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a common denominator, such as 20/12 − 9/12.
Tag when the solution subtracts fraction parts of mixed numbers after denominators are already aligned or unchanged.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step is only finding the common denominator or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag when the main action is borrowing because the fraction part would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when regrouping changes a negative or insufficient fractional part into a subtractable one.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag when the step only combines a whole result with a fraction result after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solution combines whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only performs subtraction without reducing or formatting the final answer.
Do not tag when the step only rewrites inputs before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction and mixed-number subtraction whose fractional parts have unlike denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing steps that keep the same denominator.
Do not tag for simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts numerators of like fractions directly.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators have been matched.
Tag whether the result is positive, zero, or initially negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding an LCD or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag whole-number subtraction steps by themselves.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts before the final fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or rewritten whole numbers as a separate part of the computation.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 = 1.
Tag when a whole number is treated as the whole part in a mixed-number style subtraction.
Tag even if later borrowing changes the whole-part result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction-only items with no whole-part subtraction.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless a whole-part subtraction is also performed.
Do not tag final combine steps that merely state the mixed-number answer.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when a step changes a negative or insufficient fractional part into a subtractable fraction by regrouping.
Tag for both same-denominator and unlike-denominator mixed-number contexts once the working denominator is established.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d unless an actual borrow/regroup follows.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number into a standard mixed number.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard mixed number or a whole number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or writing a whole number as n + 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten with a zero fractional part, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5 or 2 to 2 + 0/8.
Tag when the rewrite is done specifically to align forms for mixed-number subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination into a mixed number.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or a mixed number with 0 fractional part is written as an integer.
Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into the final accepted form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction step itself unless the step also explicitly simplifies or combines to final form.
Do not tag finding a common denominator.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps unless they also perform the final simplification/output formatting.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a least common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Applies to pure fractions or to fractional parts of mixed numbers.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of borrowing rather than denominator matching.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard mixed number or whole-number form into a standard subtraction-ready form, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part or expressing a whole number as a mixed number with 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 4/3 to 3 1/3.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when the rewrite is done to prepare whole and fractional parts for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag conversion to equivalent fractions for unlike denominators; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun; that is S04.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole and fraction parts directly, whether or not borrowing is later needed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting equivalent fractions; that is S01.
Do not tag the borrowing/regrouping action used to fix a negative fractional result; that is S04.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction; that is S05.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to d/d or equivalent fractional units.
Tag when borrowing is used after obtaining a negative fractional difference or anticipating one.
Tag when the borrowed whole is combined with an existing fractional part before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d before subtraction begins; that is S02.
Do not tag final combination of the answer after borrowing is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or recognize that a zero-fraction or mixed number with 0 fractional part simplifies to a whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/d is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction itself.
Do not tag combining already-simplified whole and fraction parts into a mixed number unless an actual reduction or whole-number simplification occurs.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts and express the answer in an acceptable final form such as a mixed number, fraction, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one mixed number.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as a simple fraction.
Tag when the final answer statement reflects assembling previously computed parts into the required form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simplification by reduction to lowest terms; that is S05.
Do not tag subtraction operations that produce the component parts; that is S03.
Do not tag preparatory rewrites before subtraction; that is S02.
